summary: Require root AGENTS.md as the .go execution gateway
description: Make every repository with a .go contract carry a root AGENTS.md that directs agents into the repository-local .go source of truth, defines the mandatory Go routing/read/validation behavior, preserves repository-specific obligations, and is installed or repaired by supported bootstrap/update paths without overwriting unrelated instructions.
acceptance: A repository with .go but without root AGENTS.md fails validation with an actionable repair instruction; AGENTS.md casing and root location are explicit.
Bootstrap, adoption, migration and update paths install or safely repair a bounded Go gateway block while preserving repository-specific instructions outside that block.

The gateway points agents to .go as repository source of truth and requires reading vision, architecture principles, hierarchy, selected task, validation/status/router, scoped execution, evidence, critic/repair and completion rules.

The contract permits extra repository obligations and does not impose irrelevant global policy; fixtures, docs and the project template compatibility check prove fresh and existing repository behavior.
The change is covered by good/bad migration and validation tests and is released with immutable local and remote readback evidence.
